art:precios: Flavored goods (wine, juice, jelly, pickles, dried goods, smoked fish, honey and aged roe) get their price from formulas in the game's code: wine ×3, juice ×2.25, jelly and pickles ×2 + 50, dried ×7.5 + 25 (per 5 items), smoked ×2, honey 100 + flower ×2, roe 30 + fish ÷ 2 and aged roe roe ×2.
art:barrica: In a cask, quality goes from normal to iridium in 56 days divided by the item's aging speed; each star multiplies the price (silver ×1.25, gold ×1.5, iridium ×2).
art:tiempo: Times are in in-game minutes; a night of sleep counts as one day, so days are approximate.
herr:conv: Besides the gold, Clint asks for 5 bars of the upgrade's metal (copper, iron, gold or iridium) and the tool takes 2 days to be ready.
